text:
anika: quick check-in: Nimbus pilot launch gating. We have three weeks before customer demo window, need to confirm cross-team blockers and finalize runbook.

leah: thanks. top-level asks from product: SLA target (latency + availability), quality baseline on our canonical prompts, clear rollback thresholds, and the customer data residency checklist completed.

tom: runtime notes: the 6bit quant path (r6_q6) reduces cost but we haven't validated token accuracy on the NLU prompts. Also observed KV-cache cold-start latency spikes at scale during last stress run. Will run targeted tests.

marta: infra: we can carve a dedicated pool but need exact prewarm TTL and prefetch policy. Also need the VPC peering cidr to be finalized to complete firewall rules.

ben: security: Nimbus requires FIPS-like key wrapping and audit-grade logging. HSM integration is in progress but vendor attestation ETA is 5 business days. Until attestation, security cannot enable prod keys.

leah: acceptable interim: use test HSM with strict audit mirroring to prod logs, but no prod keys until attested. We should document this as a conditional gate.

tom: proposal for runtime gating: run two 4hr soaks: one with r6_q6 at expected concurrency, one with r8_fp16 as control. Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token delta, hallucination rate on prompt set. Owner: tom. Due: 2026-03-31.

marta: infra tasks: (1) allocate 3xV100-equivalent nodes for pilot window (owner: marta, due: 2026-03-29), (2) prewarm policy: phased 20/60/100% across 3hrs before window (owner: marta, due: 2026-04-03), (3) finalize net CIDR for peering: need product confirmation (owner: marta, due: 2026-03-27).

ben: security tasks: (1) vendor attestation follow-up (owner: ben, due: 2026-03-26), (2) KMS keyflow diagram + threat model (owner: ben, due: 2026-03-25), (3) audit ingestion test to SIEM (owner: ben + marta, due: 2026-03-28).

leah: product tasks: canonical prompt set + expected quality thresholds (owner: leah, due: 2026-03-24), acceptance plan for rollback and customer communication templates (owner: leah, due: 2026-03-29).

tom: fallback strategy suggestion: routing policy that shifts 100% traffic to hosted model if p95 > 400ms for a 3m window OR error rate > 1% for 2m. Need to confirm hosted variant id and cost delta.

marta: cost note: full prewarm at scale could double the infra spend for the pilot week. Recommend staggered prewarm plus telemetry gating.

anika: clarification: customer demo window is 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-14. Pilot should include a canary day on 2026-04-10. Reserve resources around those dates.

ben: question: do we allow customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key)? Nimbus asked for BYOK. That changes onboarding.

leah: for pilot we will support test BYOK in staging only; production BYOK requires HSM attestation and policy sign-off. Document this in onboarding checklist.

ci-bot: pipeline:staging -> run:integration-tests triggered by tom at 2026-03-22T07:12:03Z :white_check_mark:

tom: I'll attach initial soak graphs and hallucination sampling to the thread when ready.

marta: I'll open the reservation ticket and link it here (infra-ticket #7892).

anika: decision checkpoint on 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC: proceed to pilot if (A) r6_q6 soak p95 <= 300ms and hallucination delta <= 2% vs r8_fp16; (B) HSM attestation received or mitigation path documented; (C) net/infra reserved. If any fail, postpone canary one week.

leah: agree. Also add an on-call rotation for the demo period: owner: runtime on-call + infra on-call + security lead. Derek will you volunteer to curate the rotation? (Note: derek is out this thread, will ping).

anika: thanks everyone. We will reconvene 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC to review progress.
